topic: Average teen tutoring rate vs minimum wage — why hustles beat first jobs
caption:
Your teen already knows enough to get paid for it.

Teen tutors earn $20-$30 an hour using skills they built in school — no resume, no interview, no waiting to turn 16.

A side hustle teaches them what a first job rarely does: how to find a client, set a rate, and show up like a pro.

copy.headline: What teens charge for tutoring other students
copy.body: Teen tutors routinely earn $20-$30/hr helping peers in math, science, or test prep — often 2-3x the $10-$15 minimum wage at a first job.
